data_objects.name: coded_feature_labels
data_objects.meaning: Row-level binary outcomes paired with one nullable integer-coded feature.

variables.name: column_1
variables.meaning: Nullable categorical or ordinal code represented as floating-point values 0 through 6.

variables.name: label
variables.meaning: Binary outcome represented as floating-point 0.0 or 1.0.

structure.description: Each row is an independent feature-label observation; the file supplies no explicit row identifier.

uncertainties: The meaning and ordering of the codes in column_1 and the positive-class definition of label are not documented.
annotation_notes: Blank CSV fields represent missing column_1 values; they are distinct from code 0.0.
